data.description: Luxury Living | Dual Sea Views | High ROI
data.display_address: Ellington Ocean House, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai
data.long_description:
Ellington Properties presents Ocean House, a luxurious beachfront residential community on Palm Jumeirah, offering a unique living experience curated for residents who seek an unparalleled lifestyle. Ocean House provides a selection of exquisite apartments with stunning views of the Burj Khalifa, Burj Al Arab, Marina Skyline, Palm Jumeirah, and the Arabian Gulf.

Property Details:
- 2 Bedrooms
- 3 Bathrooms
- 1 Parking Space
- 2,103.05 sq. ft

Amenities:
- Hotel-style drop-off areas
- Elegant lobbies
- Indoor and outdoor fitness centers
- Infinity pool
- Children's play area
- Cinema room
- Games room

Located in the coveted Palm Jumeirah community, Ocean House offers access to a variety of entertainment options including fine dining, nightlife, and family-friendly activities. With a quick drive to Sheikh Zayed Road, the Palm is well-connected to the rest of Dubai and home to several 5-star hotels and exceptional dining options, making it a prime destination for indulging in life’s luxuries.
